eventDetail.scope: 2026 IEEE Sustainable Power Energy Conference (iSPEC) aims to advance sustainable energy systems by addressing the key challenges and enhancing innovation in areas like renewable energy integration, smart grids, and energy storage. The conference focuses on improving grid resilience, enhancing energy efficiency, reducing carbon emissions, and leveraging AI, IoT, and advanced digital technologies for optimization and predictive maintenance. It also emphasizes the economic and policy frameworks, social responsibility, and environmental governance to promote sustainable development. By uniting researchers, industry professionals, and policymakers, iSPEC serves as a platform to explore cutting-edge solutions, share knowledge, and shape the future of clean and reliable energy systems.
